group.name: Additional patches - each is useful only with the mod it patches

plugin.name: SL Kidnapped Redux Patch
plugin.description:
When SL Kidnapped Redux finishes its own sequence, it hands you to DAC rather than returning you back to original spot. Also adds scene control over what NPC types can participate in scenes and limits which Devious Devices it equips.
Option to exclude captive NPCs from the scenes. Option to skip the scenes entirely and jump straight to DAC capture.
Uses its own MCM.
SkyrimNet instegration: - NPC ambushers are aware that they came to capture you. - NPCs differentiate between the captors and captives
Needs SL Kidnapped Redux and it's OStim patch. Harmless if absent - the patch simply never activates.

plugin.name: Leash Framework Patch
plugin.description:
On capture, NPCs apply a physical leash that stops you leaving.
Carries its own MCM.
Needs LeashFramework. Harmless if absent - the patch simply never activates.

plugin.name: Dark Arena Patch
plugin.description:
During Dark Arena pit fights, nearby NPCs know a fight is happening and who is winning, and your opponent knows they are facing you.
EXPERIMENTAL: during the "serve X clients" quest, you can offer your services through SkyrimNet and they should count as a valid client.
Defeat and Capture keeps its capture from firing while a Dark Arena debt is unpaid, and stops the player being killed in a pit fight.
Needs Dark Arena and its OStim patch. Harmless if absent - the quest simply never starts. Technically doesn't need DAC either.
